description: SUMO City-Scale Traffic and EV Charging Examples is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Juan Alberto Gallardo-Gómez, José-Luis Guisado-Lizar (Universidad de Sevilla). Reproducible SUMO resources for city-scale traffic stress testing and electric-vehicle charging-station modelling. The repository includes a Python script for inserting lateral charging stations into SUMO road networks, a Seville traffic stress-test scenario, and a charging-station capacity stress-test scenario. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is EPL-2.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
